summary: Plan stakeholder engagement, map interests and track feedback with practical course exercises. Explore the five-day foundation outline.
lede: Stakeholder management training helps project coordinators, engagement officers and service leads connect stakeholder input to decisions. For live initiatives, participants practise mapping interests and influence with stakeholder registers and Mendelow’s matrix, choosing engagement methods with the IAP2 Spectrum, and recording feedback, commitments and decision links.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who coordinate decisions, consultations or service changes and need a repeatable way to connect stakeholder input with actions and records.
prerequisites: No coding is required. Familiarity with a current project, service change or consultation is useful; no prior stakeholder-management training is assumed.
